newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin sets 4-wk T-bill auction on Aug 20.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin sets 4-wk T-bill auction on Aug 20.

text.p: The Slovak central bank said on Monday it would auction an unspecified tranche of four-week finance ministry treasury bills on August 20.
In the last successful auction of similar T-bills on August 6, the average yield rose to 19.287 percent.
The ministry does not announce amounts on offer at state securities auctions or set a minimum or maximum limit price on bids.

The finance ministry uses T-bills and state bonds as the main tools to cover the state budget deficit, which widened to 17.936 billion crowns ($519.2 million) in the first seven months of this year from 13.209 billion in the first half.
